reasoning_traces.think:
The four-tier architecture defines a hierarchical Bayesian inference pipeline. Tier 1 (GitHub) provides data in CC-BY-4.0 format, while Tier 2 (TimesFM) offers non-commercial forecasts constrained by a 1T training dataset. Tier 3 (Mimo) applies causal reasoning under grounded prompts, enforcing citation and inference flags. Tier 4 (MCP) enables read-only access to public JSON, ensuring no unauthorized modification. Dualities emerge between deterministic reasoning (Tier 3) and stochastic forecasting (Tier 2). Failure modes include NC license leakage, unverified data entry, and adversarial reasoning bypasses. The system enforces a cross-layer veto: TimesFM cannot route to production without explicit commercial license, and Mimo's output is validated by MCP before delivery.
